qa_pairs.question: What chapter section is this page from?
qa_pairs.answer: This page is from Chapter 11 Engine.

qa_pairs.question: Which engine models are covered in this section?
qa_pairs.answer: This section covers the Engine M3 / 320is models.

qa_pairs.question: What page number contains the engine view information?
qa_pairs.answer: The engine view information is found on page 11-100.

qa_pairs.question: On which page can I find the compression check procedure for all cylinders?
qa_pairs.answer: The compression of all cylinders check procedure is on page 11-101.

qa_pairs.question: What are the two oil pan sections referenced in this index?
qa_pairs.answer: The two oil pan sections are the oil pan upper section and oil pan lower section, both with remove and install procedures.

qa_pairs.question: Which page covers cylinder head removal and installation?
qa_pairs.answer: Cylinder head removal and installation is covered on page 11-106.
